description: Source of truth for Zynth package release classification, version tracks, and distribution strategy.

trackDefinitions.framework-lockstep: Initial runtime packages that should move together during alpha.
trackDefinitions.cli-independent: CLI package versioned independently from framework runtime packages.
trackDefinitions.later-alpha: Public candidate package staged for a later alpha wave.

distributionDefinitions.js-built: Publish built JavaScript and type artifacts.
distributionDefinitions.native-source: Publish built JavaScript plus iOS and Android native source for consumer app toolchains.
distributionDefinitions.managed-binaries: Publish built JavaScript plus native integration files and managed binary payload support.

readinessDefinitions.ready-for-alpha-preflight: Package is part of the first alpha scope but still needs metadata, pack, and smoke validation.
readinessDefinitions.staged: Package is intentionally excluded from the first alpha and will be revisited later.
readinessDefinitions.private: Package should remain private and excluded from publish scripts.

packages.name: @zynthjs/core
packages.notes: Core runtime and renderer. Ships built JS plus iOS, Android, native, Yoga, and podspec payloads. Animation runtime (@zynthjs/core/motion) and gesture definitions (@zynthjs/core/gesture) now included as subpath exports.

packages.name: @zynthjs/apis
packages.notes: Platform API surface required by the initial framework release.

packages.name: @zynthjs/components
packages.notes: Initial public component package. Includes GestureDetector as a first-class primitive. Animated style, entering/exiting, and layout transition props are native to View.
